describes: Current native form/action integration and exact public effects.

cases.name: the-reset-form-executor
cases.covers: The real reset executor selects a name subtree, an exclusion complement, all resettable fields and an object-number field. Each reset is one current atomic op.

cases.name: an-inert-reset
cases.covers: Empty or valueless selections are inert. A real atomic engine refusal fails a selected reset and leaves every public value unchanged.

cases.name: a-failed-reset-fails-the-node
cases.covers: Atomic reset refusal fails the action node with the engine message; no selected field changes and a later refused reset remains observable.

cases.name: reset-form-action-door
cases.covers: The host reset uses the current mirrored form, defaults origin to user and does not force engine reads. Failed atomic reset rejects and preserves confirmed fields.

cases.name: the-submit-resolver
cases.covers: SubmitForm resolves its post-fill dataset through the registered form reader. Unsupported explicit buttons and NoExport fields are diagnosed; charSet is forwarded.

cases.name: resolve-submit-dataset-door
cases.covers: The host dataset uses current values and provenance, forwards charSet and explicit diagnostics, and reads no new engine snapshot after hydration.

cases.name: commit-script-form-effects
cases.covers: The script sink stages current ops immediately. Native refusal is reported by the queue; per-field authority refuses staging synchronously with a failed sink result.

cases.name: commit-sink-without-annotation
cases.covers: The same native sink confirms through form events without annotation and never reloads annotation pages.

cases.name: activation-without-actions
cases.covers: Without actions the current activateWidget door resolves its field from the object-number relationship and returns an unscripted unchanged form result; DOM events are inert.

cases.name: activation-is-delegated
cases.covers: Activation dispatches the current form row action; absent or rootless actions fall back to the form owner, without extra page reads.

cases.name: a-refused-activation-is-dispatched
cases.covers: An incomplete current widget action is refused by the dispatcher and still returns kind dispatched; the form fallback never runs.

diagnostics.message: refused: the action tree is incomplete

cases.name: the-widget-event-feed
cases.covers: Current form rows supply hover flags and action trees. Enter, exit, down, up, focus and blur carry the real widget source through the actions queue.

cases.name: hover-pre-checks-the-folded-annotation
cases.covers: The current form-row mirror owns hover flags even with annotation lending. Rows without trees skip dispatch; an exit tree dispatches on hover exit; unknown rows read the page.
